purpose: A wholesale marketplace where buyers and suppliers each bring their own assistant, and the two sides' assistants negotiate deals on their behalf.
target_audience: Wholesale buyers who negotiate many supplier deals
Suppliers with their own pricing rules and inventory

represented_negotiation.description: A buyer sets their needs and limits with their own assistant; each supplier runs their own assistant with their own pricing rules and inventory. When a buyer wants to purchase, the two independent assistants — owned by different parties, each acting only for its own side — negotiate quantity, price, and terms over the marketplace's shared protocol and bring back a proposed deal. Neither side controls or sees the other's assistant.
represented_negotiation.example: A buyer's assistant and three suppliers' assistants settle on a price and lead time; the buyer is handed the best proposed deal to approve.

deal_approval.description: Each party reviews and approves the negotiated terms before anything is committed.

differentiators: Your assistant works only for you and the other side's works only for them; the marketplace just lets them talk.
